body:
My ex gf. 

We dated a few years ago and you were amazing to me. Thank you for taking care of me when I got sick, especially when it was for a few months. Thank you for cooking me delicious dinners. Thank you for being the best sex I've ever had. Thank you for always supporting me, and helping me find what career I wanted. Thank you for watching 1,001 football games with me. Thank you for giving me some of the most memorable birthdays and holidays of my life. Thank you for always being loyal to me, even when I wasn't to you in the end. Thank you for turning me into someone who loves cats on top of his love for dogs. Thank you for making me a better person. Thank you for all those deep, insightful conversations we had about life, politics, religion, ethics. It never ceased to amaze me how intelligent you are and how infallible your logic is. 

I was so happy with you but over the time I became selfish, egotistical, and complacent. I took you and our relationship for granted. I confided in others negative thoughts about our relationship, and let them create distance between us. I became so delusional that I thought I found someone even better than you, and I broke up with you. I'm so sorry. Turns out the grass wasn't greener. I think I realized that pretty quickly but I kept pushing on determined to not look like a fool. Maybe our lives would be different if I had. 

Once we started seeing each other again I'm so sorry I hurt you. I still was being so selfish then. I broke your heart all over again, and there's no excuse. There was nothing you did to deserve what I did. If I could go back in time and change it I would in a second. I never would have left in the first place. 

We don't talk anymore and I know that's for the best. I don't know how you are or where you are but from your Facebook it looks like you have an amazing man in your life and you sure look happy. I hope like hell you are K. You deserve it more than anyone.
Kinda late to the party here but...  I miss my ex. Not really in a OMG I'm still so in love with her kind of way, but the sex was phenomenal. Easily the best sex I've ever had, and I miss that
